o1.biggest_strength: It acts on the real signals: sleep, evening posting, narrator clips, and cutting low-performing app news, focus, quote cards, and morning posts.
o1.biggest_mistake: The Wednesday 14:30 parent slot goes against the evening-save signal, and the review timing leaves a small gap for the Monday 23 November post if anything later needs approval.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Move the parent pickup idea to an evening-safe version or make it a clearly limited test, and tighten the review calendar so no reviewed post is scheduled before it can legally go live.

o2.biggest_strength: The plan is very on-brand and cleanly commits to the winning mix: sleep-led, narrator-clip-heavy, and evening-only.
o2.biggest_mistake: The success target is much too soft: calling 3,440 installs a win ignores that this new mix should reasonably aim closer to the 6,000+ install range.
o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Set sharper four-week targets for installs, save rate, and narrator clip performance, and model the expected lift from the proposed mix.

reason: I would rather use Output 1 because it gives the stronger business case and better success measures, even though Output 2 has slightly warmer copy and cleaner evening scheduling. Output 1 needs fewer strategic fixes before I could hand it to the team.
